title: Black Friday 2026: Peacock Is More Than 65% Off for 3 Months
summary: Subscribers get three months of Peacock Select for just $2.99 per month (was $8.99 per month) for a limited time.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

For Black Friday, NBCUniversal drops a new streaming deal with savings up to 67% off of Peacock’s regular price.

$2.99/month $8.99/month 67% off

Get Peacock Select

If you want to watch more movies, TV shows and live events, like the Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade, then you can upgrade to Peacock Premium for $8.99 per month for three months (was $12.99 per month) or $89.99 for the annual plan (was $129.99 per year). It’s still an impressive discount of 31% off of the annual plan. With the premium bundle, you’d have access to more movies and TV shows, including Peacock Originals and live sports.

What’s Streaming on Peacock?

Peacock is the streaming home to hits, including Dig , The Fall and Rise of Reggie Dinkins , The Paper , Saturday Night Live , The Office , Minions & Monsters , The Super Mario Galaxy Movie , Below Deck , Small Town Trouble: Texas , St. Denis Medical , The Traitors and others. It also comes with live sports from the NFL, NBA, Premier League, MLB, WNBA and other leagues.

Additionally, the bundle offers a wide selection of hot music programming, such as The Eternal Sunshine Diaries: The Making of the Tour , The Voice , Nelly & Ashanti: We Belong Together , Eurovision Song Contest and so much more.

For Black Friday weekend, Peacock starts at just $2.99 per month (was $8.99 per month) , a 67% savings, for a limited time. Learn more about the streaming deal here .

$8.99/month $12.99/month 31% off

Get Peacock Premium

The Peacock is compatible with Apple iPhone and Apple iPad, Android smartphones and tablets, smart TVs from Samsung, Vizio and LG, Roku TV, Google TV and Android TV, Apple TV 4K, Amazon Fire TV and other devices. The streaming service works with web browsers including Google Chrome, Safari and Firefox.
